metadata.question: In November 2021, did Seattle experience less than 20cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need precipitation data for Seattle in November 2021 - Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) or GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) - CHIRPS provides daily precipitation at ~5km resolution - Date: November 1-30, 2021 - Location: Seattle, WA coordinates (~47.6, -122.3) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - These are already processed climate datasets 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total precipitation = 0-200mm is reasonable - If collection is empty → C1 - If no valid pixels after processing → C2 - If result is None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., >500mm in a month for Seattle) → C3 - Compare total to 20cm (200mm): if < 200mm → A (Yes), else → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]); const startDate = '2021-11-01'; const endDate = '2021-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // CHIRPS provides daily precipitation in mm let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(seattle); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data available for November 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = precipCol.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate total precipitation in mm const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: seattle, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMm = stats.precipitation; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check for unrealistic values if (precipMm < 0 || precipMm > 1000) { console.log(`Unrealistic precipitation value: ${precipMm}mm`); console.log("C3"); return; } const precipCm = precipMm / 10; console.log(`Total precipitation in November 2021: ${precipMm.toFixed(1)}mm (${precipCm.toFixed(1)}cm)`); console.log(`Images processed: ${colSize}`); // 20cm = 200mm if (precipCm < 20) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
